list.name: sites
list.label: Sucursales
list.query: SELECT store_name AS __text, store_id AS __value FROM sites ORDER BY store_name

panels.title: Total de ingresos
panels.description: Suma de personas que ingresaron al local en el período seleccionado, sumando todas las sucursales filtradas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_day AS time, SUM(ins) AS "Ingresos" FROM counting_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tasa de captación
panels.description: Promedio ponderado del cociente ingresos / passersby (tráfico exterior detectado por WiFi/BLE).

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_day AS time, SUM(ins)::float / NULLIF(SUM(passersby), 0) AS "Captación" FROM turn_in_rate_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tasa de conversión
panels.description: Promedio ponderado del cociente ventas / ingresos. Requiere que la sucursal envíe transacciones POS.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_day AS time, SUM(sales)::float / NULLIF(SUM(visits), 0) AS "Conversión" FROM conversion_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Facturación
panels.description: Suma de ventas menos devoluciones en el período. Expresado en pesos argentinos (la unidad menor de la moneda dividida por 100).

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_day AS time, SUM(amount_minor_sale - amount_minor_return) / 100.0 AS "Facturación" FROM pos_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Ticket promedio
panels.description: Facturación neta dividida por la cantidad de ventas (excluye devoluciones del denominador).

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_day AS time, (SUM(amount_minor_sale) - SUM(amount_minor_return))::float / NULLIF(SUM(sales), 0) / 100.0 AS "Ticket promedio" FROM pos_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Duración promedio de visita
panels.description: Estimada por la Ley de Little (W = L / λ). Solo el promedio del período; no incluye distribución. Se degrada en horas pico y al abrir o cerrar el local.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_day AS time, SUM(visit_duration_minutes * arrivals) / NULLIF(SUM(arrivals), 0) AS "Duración (min)" FROM visit_duration_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Ingresos diarios y tráfico exterior
panels.description: Barras: ingresos al local por día. Líneas (eje derecho): tráfico exterior detectado por WiFi/BLE.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(c.bucket_day, w.bucket_day) AS time, SUM(c.ins) AS "Ingresos", SUM(w.passersby) AS "Tráfico exterior", SUM(w.shoppers) AS "Tráfico cercano" FROM counting_by_bucket_day c FULL OUTER JOIN wifi_ble_by_bucket_day w ON c.store_id = w.store_id AND c.bucket_day = w.bucket_day WHERE COALESCE(c.store_id, w.store_id) IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(c.bucket_day, w.bucket_day) BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY COALESCE(c.bucket_day, w.bucket_day) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Embudo de conversión
panels.description: Cascada de tráfico exterior → tráfico cercano → ingresos al local → ventas. Cada barra muestra el conteo absoluto del período.

targets.rawSql: WITH totals AS (SELECT SUM(w.passersby) AS passersby, SUM(w.shoppers) AS shoppers, SUM(c.ins) AS ingresos, SUM(p.sales) AS ventas FROM counting_by_bucket_day c FULL OUTER JOIN wifi_ble_by_bucket_day w ON c.store_id = w.store_id AND c.bucket_day = w.bucket_day FULL OUTER JOIN pos_by_bucket_day p ON COALESCE(c.store_id, w.store_id) = p.store_id AND COALESCE(c.bucket_day, w.bucket_day) = p.bucket_day WHERE COALESCE(c.store_id, w.store_id, p.store_id) IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(c.bucket_day, w.bucket_day, p.bucket_day) BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date) SELECT passersby AS "Tráfico exterior", shoppers AS "Tráfico cercano", ingresos AS "Ingresos", ventas AS "Ventas" FROM totals

panels.title: Composición demográfica de los ingresos
panels.description: Distribución de los ingresos por categoría etaria estimada (basada en altura medida por estéreo).

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(ins_adult) AS "Adultos", SUM(ins_child) AS "Niños", SUM(ins_unknown) AS "Sin clasificar" FROM counting_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date

panels.title: Top 5 sucursales por ingresos
panels.description: Las cinco sucursales que más personas recibieron en el período seleccionado.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.store_name AS "Sucursal", SUM(c.ins) AS "Ingresos" FROM counting_by_bucket_day c JOIN sites s USING (store_id) WHERE c.store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND c.bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY s.store_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

panels.title: 5 sucursales con menor conversión
panels.description: Sucursales con menor cociente ventas / ingresos en el período. Excluye sucursales sin tráfico.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.store_name AS "Sucursal", SUM(p.sales)::float / NULLIF(SUM(c.ins), 0) AS "Conversión" FROM counting_by_bucket_day c JOIN sites s USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN pos_by_bucket_day p ON c.store_id = p.store_id AND c.bucket_day = p.bucket_day WHERE c.store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND c.bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY s.store_name HAVING SUM(c.ins) > 0 ORDER BY 2 ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

panels.title: Mapa de calor — día de la semana × hora del día
panels.description: Promedio de ingresos por día de la semana y hora del día, sobre los últimos 30 días. Independiente del filtro de tiempo del dashboard para mantener significancia estadística.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_hour AS time, SUM(ins) AS "Ingresos" FROM counting_by_bucket_hour WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_hour > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY bucket_hour ORDER BY time

panels.title: Resumen por sucursal
panels.description: Tabla con los principales indicadores por sucursal. Click en el nombre para ver el detalle.

targets.rawSql: WITH actual AS (SELECT c.store_id, s.store_name, SUM(c.ins) AS ingresos, SUM(p.sales)::float / NULLIF(SUM(c.ins), 0) AS conversion, SUM(t.ins)::float / NULLIF(SUM(t.passersby), 0) AS turn_in, (COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_minor_sale), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_minor_return), 0))::float / 100 AS facturacion FROM counting_by_bucket_day c JOIN sites s USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN pos_by_bucket_day p ON c.store_id = p.store_id AND c.bucket_day = p.bucket_day LEFT JOIN turn_in_rate_by_bucket_day t ON c.store_id = t.store_id AND c.bucket_day = t.bucket_day WHERE c.store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND c.bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY c.store_id, s.store_name), previo AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(ins) AS ingresos_prev FROM counting_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - INTERVAL '7 days')::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - INTERVAL '7 days')::date GROUP BY store_id) SELECT a.store_id AS "ID", a.store_name AS "Sucursal", a.ingresos AS "Ingresos", (a.ingresos - COALESCE(pr.ingresos_prev, 0))::float / NULLIF(pr.ingresos_prev, 0) AS "Δ vs semana anterior", a.turn_in AS "Captación", a.conversion AS "Conversión", a.facturacion AS "Facturación" FROM actual a LEFT JOIN previo pr USING (store_id) ORDER BY a.ingresos DESC

panels.title: Visitantes únicos por día (WiFi/BLE)
panels.description: Cantidad de dispositivos distintos detectados por día tras stitching local del device (un dispositivo con N rotaciones de MAC cuenta como 1). Capacidad nueva post per-device events — antes el resumen pre-agregado no permitía DISTINCT cross-bucket.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_day AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_hash) AS "Visitantes únicos" FROM wifi_ble_events WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tasa de promoción a shopper
panels.description: De los visitantes únicos del período, qué porcentaje llegaron a clasificarse como shopper (RSSI máximo ≥ -55 dBm en alguna ventana) — proxy de intención de entrada. Calculado per-visitor: lifetime max RSSI del día.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_day AS time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lifetime_max_rssi >= -55)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "Promoción" FROM (SELECT bucket_day, visitor_hash, MAX(rssi_max) AS lifetime_max_rssi FROM wifi_ble_events WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day, visitor_hash) v GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Repetición intra-día (engagement)
panels.description: Distribución de visitantes según cuántas ventanas de 15 min los observaron. Visitantes en 1 ventana = pasaron rápido. Visitantes en 3+ ventanas = rondaron o se quedaron cerca — proxy de engagement.

targets.rawSql: WITH visitor_windows AS (SELECT visitor_hash, COUNT(DISTINCT period_start) AS n_windows FROM wifi_ble_events WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY visitor_hash) SELECT CASE WHEN n_windows = 1 THEN '1 ventana' WHEN n_windows = 2 THEN '2 ventanas' WHEN n_windows BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN '3-5 ventanas' ELSE '6+ ventanas' END AS "Ventanas", COUNT(*) AS "Visitantes" FROM visitor_windows GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN(n_windows)
